summary.intent: Participate in the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge: analyze Soony's confidential supply-chain data, build an agent product (poller, extraction, verification, recheck-and-act) with a polished UI, and prepare interviews, docs and a pitch before the 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's launch plan hides real shortfalls (art books overbooked 72,000, failed statue lot, game cards short, sleeve revision conflict) and built a working product (Lighthouse) with case flow, routines, phone layouts and top-bar fixes on main. Briefing page, interview doc and logo variants were produced; main remained unpushed at ~14 commits ahead of origin with the deck and logo choice still open.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip); no webhooks, so change detection must poll and compare SHA-256, since files are replaced under the same name.
data/ (raw portal data, scans, notes) and .env are gitignored; confidential data must stay out of code and commits. .env.example is committed.
Team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; tasks are claimed with a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; sessions with no repo modifications log 'skipping checkpoint', and checkpoints upload on git push.
The API does not load .env on import, so settings like ASK_VIEWER_TITLE must be read through a helper that loads .env first or they are missing after restart.

Routine steps are restricted by trigger kind: 'Chase once if no answer' only works on routines watching messages awaiting an answer, 'Ask for a status' only on shipments; the server rejects others (e.g. 'step 2 cannot be done on open decisions').
Routines call Claude (claude-opus-5-5) with the key from .env independent of ASK_LLM_PROVIDER, so they work on the demo.
The demo runs in record-only email mode; test servers should run on a copy of demo state with background off.
FlowGraph.tsx exports the connector and node box so the case flow and routine diagram share the same drawing code.
Branch work uses separate worktree folders (../ask-soony-pulse, ../ask-soony-flow); live (:8000) serves the rebuilt web app immediately, but new server endpoints need a restart.

Lucas's new-approach branch: only 'read new documents before verifying' is worth porting; its second escalation loop and pulse-console would duplicate main's escalation loop, card_alerts.py and bypass the duplicate-send guard.
workflow: Verify the intended feature before building: a Pulse-style chat was built and then reverted because the team actually liked Pulse's flow view; ask or inspect the reference first.
Use screenshots at desktop and phone size from a preview server on a copy of demo state before merging UI changes.
Layouts that snake (second row reading right to left) confuse readers; a single top-to-bottom column reads correctly.
Reuse existing components for visual consistency (shared connector/box) so styles cannot drift.
Interview notes from users (e.g. Sophia preferring decision view over chat pipeline) should drive UI direction.
Subagents are useful for bulk cross-checking (200 order confirmations, 59 scans) and for drawing logo variants without touching the repo.
Report unverified items honestly (e.g. not clicked in a browser, tests not rerun for frontend-only changes).

friction: Entire hooks looked as if they had not fired because no checkpoint was made; logs showed they had.
Portal token was empty at first, blocking data access with 401 until supplied.
New data drops arrived unannounced (five files by 14:37) and changed the analysis, with no notification API.
Built and merged the wrong UI (a second chat duplicating 'change in your words', with mismatched colours) and had to undo the merge.
The two-column flow was confusing and its arrows too faint, requiring a redesign into a single column.
Phone UI problems: empty-looking collapsed flow, overlapping bottom action bar, crowded top bar with the heartbeat absolutely positioned over the status.
'Chase once if no answer' appeared broken because the menu offered it on incompatible routine types.
Several scanned PDFs had empty text and needed rendering to images to read.
Hand-in deadline pressure at 12:00 with main many commits unpushed.
open_items: Push main (about 14 commits ahead of origin) and restart live so the sign-in choice, Maren's 'Waiting for your OK' and the heartbeat appear.
Port 'read new documents before verifying' from Lucas's new-approach branch into runner.run_pipeline, keeping the no-model skip and try/except safeguards.
Choose a Lighthouse logo variant (subagent picked 2, assistant picked 3) and apply to favicon, top bar and sign-in page.
Routines page redesign: compact list rows, one open at a time, ⋯ menu, duplicate-routine detection.
Support 'send email then chase once if no answer' on decision routines via a follow-up watching replies.
Optional phone bottom-sheet for the case list from the top bar.
Update the pitch deck and confirm the video; the deck was still open.
Parked branch jonas/pulse-ui (Describe it chat) remains unmerged.
Register sender emails in the portal and send the Karton Nowak art-book order (offer valid 24h) and Boise reply; clarify with Lio whether portal data and supplier replies are per-team.
Update the briefing page and doc to the 14:37 drop state; decide whether to delete the earlier Claude doc.
Verify the demo/live routes in a real browser, since several changes were only checked via screenshots.
